messages:
anna: Heads-up — we're doing a coordinated version bump across api, runtime, console, and sdks. Targeting cutoff in ~12h. Please flag any blockers now.

mike: Copy. Which repos/PRs should we be watching?

anna: Primary PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/412, https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/998, https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/221, https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/147.

sara: runtime PR adds kernel selection fix + minor version bump to 0.14.1. CI flaky on kv-cache test earlier, working on a flaky suppression.

jeff: console PR is docs + changelog only, should be safe. I'll merge after api and runtime are green.

linda: sdk bump includes a breaking TS type change (optional param rename). I've opened a migration note in CHANGELOG and called out to customers via internal doc.

mike: Important: API adds a response shape tweak for streaming meta — SDKs need to handle both old/new. Linda can you add a tiny runtime guard in sdk?

linda: Yep, will add safe parsing and a minor test. Targeting a patch today.

sara: CI: runtime's flaky test caused a false failure on the last run. I pushed a quick test fix in the PR branch and retriggered CI: `./ci/retry.sh runtime/998` — build queued.

release-bot: build/runtime/998 — queued

release-bot: build/runtime/998 — passed (12m)

mike: runtime green now. I kicked off api CI after rebasing to runtime/main.

release-bot: build/api/412 — passed (6m)

jeff: API/Runtime ✅. I'm going to merge console/changelog last and then cut the tagged release. Plan: merge runtime -> api -> sdk -> console, then tag. Thoughts?

anna: Order sounds good. Add a 10m pause after sdk merge to let package publishes propagate. Also please update RELEASE_NOTES.md with a single bullet per repo.

linda: SDK merged and published to npm (preview). Version 1.9.0. I bumped peer deps accordingly.

release-bot: publish/sdk-js/1.9.0 — success

jeff: Console merged. Tagging flow now: `git tag -a v0.14.1 -m "release coordinated bump"` then push tags.

mike: Tag pushed for runtime and api. Starts rollout to staging.

release-bot: release/staging/runtime-0.14.1 — deployed (staging)

anna: Quick sanity: smoke test on staging passed for chat streaming and embeddings. No errors in logs.

sara: Noted one warning in runtime logs about kv cache eviction, but it's a degraded metric not user-facing. I'll open a follow-up ticket to investigate and pin to backlog.

mike: Changelogs updated and consolidated in the release PR description. Final step: cut prod release at 2026-08-18T18:00 UTC unless any major regressions.

linda: One quick heads-up — SDK consumers with strict TS will need the migration note. I posted a snippet in the release PR.

jeff: All right, rolling to prod in ~30m then. If anyone sees >5% error increase, ping #incidents and we'll rollback.

anna: Thanks all — great coordination. If anything crops up after deploy, we'll triage in this thread. :thumbsup:

mike: ack

sara: ack, following the logs

release-bot: deploy/prod/runtime-0.14.1 — success

release-bot: deploy/prod/api-0.14.1 — success

jeff: prod tags pushed for console and sdk. Release complete.

anna: Closing out — created follow-ups: runtime-123 (kv-cache investigation), sdk-456 (type compatibility tests). Nice work.
